map.由气温与相对湿度，先求水汽压 e，再按 Humidex = T + 0.5555: From air temperature and relative humidity, first find the vapor pressure e, then compute the humid-heat apparent index via Humidex = T + 0.5555·(e − 10).
map.30–39 需注意，40+ 危险，45+ 极危险（加拿大标准）。: 30-39 take note, 40+ dangerous, 45+ extremely dangerous (Canadian standard).
map.加拿大系用气温+水汽压算闷热指数。: The Canadian system uses temperature + vapor pressure to compute the muggy index.
map.对比炎热指数看中高纬湿热。: Compare with the heat index for mid-to-high latitude humidity.
map.30°C、水汽压 e≈29.6 hPa → Humidex=30+0.5555×: 30°C, vapor pressure e≈29.6 hPa → Humidex=30+0.5555×(29.6−10)=30+10.9≈40.9, at the "very high discomfort" level.
map.Humidex 30–39 不适、40–44 痛苦、45–49 危险、≥50 极: Humidex 30-39 uncomfortable, 40-44 distressing, 45-49 dangerous, ≥50 extremely dangerous; in this example 40.9 falls into the distressing level.
map.Humidex 和 Heat Index 区别？: What is the difference between Humidex and Heat Index?
map.都用温湿，但 Humidex 直接加「水汽压修正项(0.5555(e−10))」: Both use temperature and humidity, but Humidex directly adds a "vapor pressure correction term (0.5555(e−10))", while the heat index uses a full polynomial; the values are close but the basis differs slightly.
map.水汽压 e=RH/100×饱和水汽压（Tetens 式），再代入 Humidex: Vapor pressure e=RH/100×saturation vapor pressure (Tetens formula), then substitute into Humidex.
